dialogues.speaker: Aigouy
dialogues.text: The Fortress of Meropide has lots of pipelines. Someone needs to maintain them, don't they? That's our job.

dialogues.speaker: Aigouy
dialogues.text: It's mostly minor repairs, patching this and that up. I mean, what do they expect someone like me to do if something major happens, anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Aigouy
dialogues.text: I just do what I'm able to, like taking letters into the city for people when I have a day off...
